correctness.rationale: Every real count signal has a unique constant-plus-three-threshold decomposition whose coefficient sum is exactly adjacent variation. The L2 triangle inequality and strict Hilbert convexity reduce the norm and all equality cases to single jumps; Bernoulli product Fourier orthogonality gives the explicit F1,F2,F3, and independent rational transition matrices check them. F1 dominates F3 at p<1/2, and the exact F2−F1 factorization yields a sign polynomial B. Its rigorous strict increase in p and strict convexity in retention prove every transition, the unique coalescence point and rational double-switch witness; the proof covers open boundaries and reflection. The checker passed 2164 rational/numerical assertions, supplementing rather than replacing the universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural sharp approximation-error norm for the smallest nontrivial binomial Ehrenfest system is completely classified for all bias and retention parameters, including every equality case. A rigorous reentrant majority-versus-rare-count jump change and unique cusp refute a noise-independent extremizer, while the two-bit obstruction establishes the minimum system size at which this effect can arise. A rational double-switch witness and exact polynomial phase boundaries make the finding reusable as a semigroup approximation benchmark rather than an arbitrary small enumeration.
